overall_assessment.realism: The samples are highly realistic, reflecting plausible model poisoning attack scenarios across diverse ML domains including spam detection, NLP sentiment analysis, email phishing detection, and autonomous vehicle object detection. The technical details such as file hashes, timestamps, training logs, anomaly alerts, and adversarial training code snippets are credible and consistent with real-world ML pipeline monitoring and attack detection practices. The inclusion of specific perturbation techniques, metrics degradation, and MITRE ATT&CK references further enhances authenticity.
overall_assessment.consistency: The dataset maintains strong consistency and schema adherence across all samples. Each entry includes a scenario description, detailed technical data with manifest snippets, poisoned sample metadata, training logs, post-training metrics, anomaly alerts, adversarial training code snippets, indicators, detection methods, and relevant MITRE techniques. Field naming is uniform, and data types are appropriate. Minor variations in key names (e.g., 'poisoned_sample_metadata' vs. 'poisoned_email_metadata') are contextually justified by data type differences and do not detract from overall consistency.
